AspendoraExperiments.ReportDocumentation: Visits and conversions split by experiment variant. Variants are assigned client-side by bundle.js (window.__asp.exp config, persistent per device, exposed as html class asp-exp-<name>-<variant>) and tracked as Experiment events. Conversions = goal conversions plus the AspendoraAttribution conversion events. Significance is a two-proportion z-test against the first (alphabetical) variant — treat as directional until samples are large.
